scripts.watch: tsc -p . --outDir dist/ -w & ( cd dist/; watchify --exclude electron --bare index.js -d -v -o 'cat > scxml-tool.js; sorcery -i scxml-tool.js;' -v )
scripts.build: npm run transpile && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: cd dist/; browserify --exclude electron --bare  index.js  -d -v -o scxml-tool.js; sorcery -i scxml-tool.js
scripts.minify: cd dist/; uglifyjs scxml-tool.js --in-source-map scxml-tool.js.map  --source-map scxml-tool.min.js.map  -o scxml-tool.min.js
scripts.package: npm run build-prod && rm `find dist -type f | grep -v dist/scxml-tool.min.js` && electron-packager --overwrite --ignore 'src/.*' . scxml-tool
scripts.build-prod: npm run transpile && npm run bundle-prod && npm run minify-prod
scripts.bundle-prod: cd dist/; browserify --exclude electron --bare  index.js  -d -v -o scxml-tool.js
